thing-type.label: Solarman Logger
thing-type.description: This thing allows communication with Solarman (IGEN-Tech) v5 based solar inverter data loggers over the local network. Compatible with inverters from manufacturers such as Deye, Sofar, Solis, ZCS Azzurro, and KStar.

parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Hostname
parameter.description: Hostname or IP address of the Solarman logger.

parameter.name: inverterType
parameter.label: Inverter Type
parameter.description: The type of inverter connected to the logger (default deye_sg04lp3).

parameter.name: serialNumber
parameter.label: Serial Number
parameter.description: Serial number of the Solarman logger.

parameter.name: solarmanLoggerMode
parameter.label: Logger Mode
parameter.description: Use RAW Modbus for LAN Stick LSE-3 and V5 MODBUS for most Wi-Fi sticks. If your Wi-Fi stick uses Raw Modbus, choose RAW. If you do not use this advanced option, V5 MODBUS will be the default.

parameter.name: additionalRequests
parameter.label: Additional Requests
parameter.description: Additional requests besides the ones defined in a legacy inverter definition. Not supported by advanced profiles. Format: mb_functioncode1:start1-end1, mb_functioncode2:start2-end2, ... Example: 0x03:0x0000-0x0100,0x03:0x0200-0x0300

parameter.name: timeZone
parameter.label: Device Time Zone
parameter.description: IANA time zone for the advanced profile inverter clock, for example Europe/Lisbon. Defaults to the openHAB system time zone. Legacy definitions use the system time zone.

parameter.name: slaveId
parameter.label: Modbus Slave ID
parameter.description: Modbus unit address of the inverter connected to the logger.

channel-type.label: Sunsynk Power
channel-type.description: Power reading or control value for a profile-specific Deye/Sunsynk channel.

channel-type.label: Sunsynk Voltage
channel-type.description: Voltage reading or control value for a profile-specific Deye/Sunsynk channel.

channel-type.label: Sunsynk Current
channel-type.description: Current reading or control value for a profile-specific Deye/Sunsynk channel.

channel-type.label: Sunsynk Capacity
channel-type.description: Battery state of charge or capacity target for a profile-specific Deye/Sunsynk channel.

channel-type.label: Sunsynk Program Time
channel-type.description: Start time in HH:mm format for a profile-specific Deye/Sunsynk program period.
